title: Generative molecule evolution using 3D pharmacophore for efficient Structure-Based Drug Design
abstract: arXiv:2507.20130v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Recent breakthroughs in generative models have shown great promise for drug discovery, yet Structure-Based Drug Design (SBDD) faces two critical challenges: the scarcity of high-quality protein-ligand complex data and the practical synthesizability of generated molecules. While ligand-based approaches benefit from billion-scale small molecule datasets, they often lack the structural context of the target protein. To address these dual challenges of data scarcity and synthetic inaccessibility, we propose MEVO, a generative molecular evolutionary framework that operates within a synthesizable chemical space. MEVO introduces a reaction-aware generative model trained on reaction routes constructed by applying predefined reaction templates to Enamine Building Blocks. translated_title: 利用三维药效团的生成式分子进化实现高效的基于结构的药物设计
translated_abstract: 生成式模型的最新突破为药物发现展现了巨大前景，然而基于结构的药物设计（SBDD）面临两个关键挑战：高质量蛋白质-配体复合物数据的稀缺性，以及所生成分子的实际可合成性。基于配体的方法虽然受益于十亿规模的小分子数据集，但往往缺乏靶蛋白的结构信息。为了解决数据稀缺和合成不可达的双重挑战，我们提出了MEVO——一个在可合成化学空间中运行的生成式分子进化框架。MEVO引入了一种反应感知的生成模型，该模型通过将预定义反应模板应用于Enamine砌块构建的反应路径进行训练。该模型联合生成分子以及符合这些模板的对应合成路线草图。通过将这种生成能力整合到口袋感知的分子进化过程中（摘要原文在此处被截断）。
tldr: 提出了MEVO框架，通过反应感知的生成模型在可合成化学空间中进行基于三维药效团的分子进化，同时解决了基于结构药物设计中蛋白质-配体复合物数据稀缺和生成分子难以合成的两大难题。
en_tdlr: MEVO, a generative molecular evolution framework using 3D pharmacophore with a reaction-aware generative model trained on reaction templates, addresses both protein-ligand data scarcity and molecular synthesizability challenges in Structure-Based Drug Design.
